name: gg_ttx_ew
scheme_description: Full NLO EW (all one-loop graphs of the selected order, QCD-EW mixed included) in the G_mu scheme with on-shell real masses, matching OpenLoops ew_scheme=1/ew_renorm_scheme=1 and the MG5 loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu default restriction (massless light fermions, diagonal CKM). Real on-shell mass renormalization (MadLoop complex_mass_scheme False, Recola set_on_shell_scheme, OpenLoops complex_mass_scheme=0) with all widths zero; stable top; Feynman gauge. Recola's default complex-mass scheme keeps absorptive self-energy parts in its counterterms even at zero widths and is therefore not used.
scope: Independent provider references at exact on-shell decimal points; binary64 provider arithmetic; timings are single-run by-products, not benchmarks.
convention: MadLoop/BLHA C_eps=(4pi)^eps/Gamma(1-eps); F_MadLoop=F_Recola+pi^2/6*D; OpenLoops truepoles=1, polenorm=0; physical couplings, no alpha extraction; initial spin/colour average and final identical-particle factor included

point_construction.construction: tools/loop_reference/exact_points.py: deterministic exact terminating-decimal sequential construction; mass shells and momentum conservation exact

error_metric: |a-b|/max(|a|,|b|,|Born|*coupling/(2pi)) for Laurent coefficients, |a-b|/max(|a|,|b|) for Born; strict relative errors also listed per row

madloop.timing_scope: single thread pinned; point 1 evaluated once untimed for initialization, then each point timed once (points 2..n,1); includes all actual poles; not a benchmark campaign
